description: Making Power Affordable for Africa and Viable for Its Utilities is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Power system and utilities", published or maintained by Chris Trimble (World Bank Group). The databases contain all the technical, financial, and tariff data collected through the study "Making power affordable in Africa and viable for its utilities." The final study and background papers are available at The objective of making the database public is to make data collected through the study available to utility companies, regulators, and practitioners ... Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa. It has 3 files in XLS. The portal files it under Power system and utilities. The portal gives 2016 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
